title: Why Did I Walk In Here?

sources.title: Radvansky, Krawietz & Tamplin (2011), Walking through doorways causes forgetting: Further explorations
McFadyen et al. (2021), Event boundaries and memory: Revisiting the doorway effect

lines.text: Ever walk into a room and forget why you came?
lines.caps: Walk into a room | and forget why?

lines.text: One study found that crossing a doorway can make a remembered intention harder to retrieve.
The idea is that your brain files the new room as a new event, pushing the old goal out of focus.
lines.caps: A new scene | shifts your focus

lines.text: But later research found the effect depends on the situation. So what were you looking for?
